::: {#rem-pmf-pdf-reference-measures}
#### PMFs and PDFs differ in the reference measure

A [PDF](#def-pdf) plays the role of a [PMF](#def-pmf)
with [Lebesgue measure](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/measures.html#def-lebesgue-measure) in place of counting measure:
@def-pdf integrates it with $dx$.
The distribution of a random variable whose CDF $F$ is absolutely continuous
has $F'$ as a [Radon--Nikodym derivative](#def-density-measure) with respect to Lebesgue measure
[@billingsley1995probability, p. 423].
So a PMF and a PDF are both [densities with respect to a measure](#def-density-measure),
for different reference measures.
That shared role is why these notes write $f_X$ for both,
and why the [joint-distribution form of Fubini--Tonelli](expectation.qmd#cor-fubini-joint)
covers PMFs, PDFs, and density-mass functions in one statement.

:::
